androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:title: Prime UW when camera becomes active
androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:summary: Workaround for some Pixel phones with ultrawide autofocus: performs one discarded ultrawide capture when the camera starts to avoid a blurry first photo.

androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:title: Save individual wide/ultrawide photos
androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:summary: When off, only the *_sbs.jpg file is written (recommended)

Preference.android:title: Compatibility test
Preference.android:summary: Check whether this phone supports 3D photos, 3D video and live 3D preview, and share a report.

Preference.android:title: Make 3D video from a recording
Preference.android:summary: Align, colour-match and combine a wide + ultrawide recording into one side-by-side 3D video.

ListPreference.android:title: Main lens focus
ListPreference.android:dialogTitle: Main lens focus (the ultrawide is always fixed-focus)

androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:title: 3D correction
androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:summary: Align size, rotation and height, fix ultrawide distortion, match colour and set the stereo window (like Stereo Photo Maker). Off = original simple alignment.

androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:title: Average colour of both lenses
androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:summary: Both lenses meet at their average colour and brightness. Off = the ultrawide copies the main lens (usually brighter).

androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:title: Cross-eyed layout
androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:summary: Save the side-by-side image as right|left for cross-eyed viewing. Off = left|right (parallel / VR).

androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:title: Swap left and right
androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:summary: Use if near objects look farther away than far ones.

androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:title: Stereo video JSON log
androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:summary: Write a JSON log per recording for sync/diagnostics

androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:title: Stereo photo JSON log
androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:summary: Write a tiny JSON log per photo for sync (sensor time + exposure per lens)

androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:title: Photo sync toast
androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:summary: Show a quick Δstart/overlap toast after each photo

Preference.android:title: Dump device/camera info (one-time)
Preference.android:summary: Write a JSON dump (streams, fps ranges, capabilities, etc.) to Documents
